items.title: MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation
items.title_zh: MUSE-Autoskill：通过技能创建、记忆、管理与评估实现自我进化的智能体
items.summary: ByteDance's skill-centric agent framework manages skills through a lifecycle of creation, memory, management, evaluation and refinement, with unit tests and runtime feedback driving improvement while skill-level memory accumulates experience. Experiments on SkillsBench report gains in task success, efficiency, reuse and cross-agent transfer.

items.title: Frontier LLM-based agents can overcome the ontology curation bottleneck for natural phenotypes
items.title_zh: 前沿 LLM 智能体有望突破自然表型本体标注的瓶颈
items.summary: Five frontier hosted LLMs from Anthropic and OpenAI acted as agentic curators, each working in a self-contained workspace with the source publication PDF, the original annotation guide, four project ontologies and a validation script. Against the original gold standard, every agent fell within the range of inter-curator variability of three trained biocurators, and all substantially outperformed Semantic CharaParser on four metrics.

items.title: Better Later Than Sooner: Neuro-Symbolic Knowledge Graph Construction via Ontology-grounded Post-extraction Correction
items.title_zh: Better Later Than Sooner：基于本体约束后置修正的神经符号知识图谱构建
items.summary: The paper proposes a neuro-symbolic pipeline for ontology-grounded knowledge graph construction that combines open-domain extraction, embedding-based canonicalization of types and predicates, and targeted LLM correction of ontology violations deferred to a post-extraction stage. It reports substantially lower token usage, improved KG consistency and preserved downstream QA quality, and measures SPARQL graph patterns to show the graphs suit symbolic querying.

items.title: Real-rootedness of the Poincaré polynomials of $\overline{\mathcal M}_{0,n}$: an AI-assisted proof
items.title_zh: 模空间 Poincaré 多项式的实根性：一个 AI 辅助证明
items.summary: The authors prove real-rootedness of the Poincaré polynomial of the Deligne-Mumford moduli space of stable n-pointed rational curves, settling a conjecture of Aluffi-Chen-Marcolli through a bivariate deformation that reveals a hidden interlacing structure. They report that the proof was obtained through an iterative AI-assisted workflow with Co-Mathematician, an agentic frontier-model system developed by Google DeepMind, while the authors formulated the problem, evaluated proof attempts and requested corrections.

items.title: FormInv: A Measurement Protocol for Semantic Invariance in Mathematical Reasoning Benchmarks
items.title_zh: FormInv：数学推理基准中语义不变性的测量协议
items.summary: FormInv audits paraphrase quality in mathematical reasoning benchmarks and introduces the Conditional Inconsistency Rate, which measures how often a semantically equivalent rewording flips a model's known-correct answer. A MathCheck audit found 4 incorrect paraphrases in 129 groups, enough to reorder model rankings, and 47% of auto-generated connective-variation paraphrases in the authors' own dataset were judged semantically incorrect.

items.title: Beyond Recall: Behavioral Specification as an Interpretive Layer for AI Personalization
items.title_zh: 超越召回：将行为规范作为 AI 个性化的解释层
items.summary: The paper introduces representational accuracy to measure how faithfully an AI system captures a person's interpretation and operationalizes it as a Behavioral Specification that compresses personal data into interpretive patterns. Across 14 autobiographical corpora it recovers most of what a raw corpus provides at roughly 25x less context cost, and it is tested alongside Mem0, Letta, Supermemory and Zep.

items.title: Mind Your Tone: Does Tone Alter LLM Performance?
items.title_zh: 注意语气：语气会改变 LLM 的表现吗？
items.summary: The study tests whether prompt tone changes LLM accuracy on objective multiple-choice questions using a 50-question set with five tone variants and a 570-question MMLU subset spanning 57 subjects with seven tone variants. Across ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT-5-nano, Gemini 2.5 Flash and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, tonal effects are systematic but highly model-dependent, and the authors caution against assuming tone-robust reliability.

items.title: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
items.title_zh: MobileGym：面向移动 GUI Agent 研究的可验证高并行仿真平台
items.summary: MobileGym is a browser-hosted mobile simulation environment that judges outcomes deterministically over structured JSON state and can run hundreds of parallel instances per server. It includes a 416-template benchmark, and GRPO training on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct gained 12.8 points on the test set.

items.title: VitaBench 2.0: Evaluating Personalized and Proactive Agents in Long-Term User Interactions
items.title_zh: VitaBench 2.0：评估长期用户交互中的个性化与主动式 Agent
items.summary: LongCat's VitaBench 2.0 orders tasks into per-user temporal sequences in which preferences are scattered across fragmented interactions, testing whether agents can extract, update and proactively seek missing information. It reports that frontier proprietary and open models still fall well short of practical personalization.

items.title: ReasonBreak: Probing Vulnerabilities in Reasoning-Enabled Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: ReasonBreak：探测面向自动驾驶的推理增强视觉-语言-动作模型漏洞
items.summary: The paper presents the first systematic black-box study of reasoning-enabled vision-language-action models under realistic textual input corruptions, using NVIDIA's Alpamayo models as representative industry systems. It reports up to 89% attack success rate on reasoning and up to 72% on trajectory manipulation in closed-loop simulation, along with a reasoning-aware evaluation framework and a benchmark for attacks and defenses.

items.title: backnotprop/pstack
items.title_zh: backnotprop/pstack：面向严谨 AI 辅助工程的技能与原则
items.summary: pstack packages skills and principles for rigorous AI-assisted engineering, built for use with Claude, Codex and pi. The JavaScript repository had 2,805 stars and 212 forks and is tagged agent-skills and claude-code.

items.title: JuneYaooo/nihaisha-nishi-tcm
items.title_zh: JuneYaooo/nihaisha-nishi-tcm：倪海厦中医课程学习的 Agent 技能
items.summary: An Agent Skill for studying Ni Haixia's traditional Chinese medicine courses, covering course retrieval, formula-pattern and acupoint lookup, study-note organization and screenshot evidence indexing. The Python repository had 2,198 stars and 477 forks.

items.title: Building self-improving tax agents with Codex
items.title_zh: 用 Codex 构建可自我改进的税务智能体
items.summary: OpenAI describes how OpenAI, Thrive and Crete built a self-improving tax agent with Codex that automates filings, improves accuracy and accelerates workflows.
